# Pull request

## Summary

Briefly describe what changed and why.

## Related issue

Closes #

## UI evidence

Add screenshots or a recording for user-facing changes. Write “Not applicable” when there are none.

## Checklist for Developer

- [ ] I linked the related issue(s).
- [ ] I added or updated unit tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I added or updated e2e tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I ran relevant tests locally.
- [ ] I ran linting and formatting checks.
- [ ] I updated documentation where appropriate.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for accidental secrets, credentials, and unrelated changes.
